Builds the matrix 70000780..7bf from 003eb2b0 with a clamped row 3, mirrors 70000b90..bcf, copies both to 00963a40/90, emits packet records on the render-context streams +0x550/+0x540, lays out a grid through 001537f0/00154100 into the 0053cd50.. region, and draws the shared LCG 0011ad58 once, or three times when [gp+2f80] % (draw % 180 + 40) == 0 (frame 10178).
